prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation sprite atlas, actual transparent alpha background.
Reference image1 defines the exact character identity: same orange office fox, fluffy white cheeks and chest, large round black glasses, white short-sleeved shirt, navy necktie, dark trousers, black shoes, employee badge and wristwatch. Reference image2 defines the BLACK OFFICE CHAIR and intended action only; do not copy its dark background or grid.
Create ONE atlas with EIGHT ordered frames in a precise 4-column x 2-row uniform grid. Landscape1536x1024 or higher same aspect. Every cell same fixed camera/scale/baseline, one complete fox and same chair completely inside cell with generous 8% padding. Actual empty alpha transparency; no background, beige/color halos, floor, shadows, lines, text, labels or cell borders.
Action ONE SHOT standing up from black office swivel chair. Frames reading row-major:
1 seated upright in chair, feet on ground, hands on armrests.
2 leans torso forward, elbows start pushing armrests.
3 bends forward farther and begins lifting hips.
4 hips rise halfway from seat, knees still bent, hands bracing chair.
5 almost standing with legs partially extended, palms moving away from armrests.
6 upright standing beside/in front of chair, arms lowering.
7 settles fully upright, legs straight, hands down.
8 standing relaxed, looks at viewer, small pleasant smile.
The chair MUST remain exactly the same shape and fixed position through ALL eight frames; no chair appears/disappears, no new furniture. Fox never turns, walks or changes clothes. Feet ground line same y throughout, body height naturally increases through standing up. Preserve original face, fur, glasses and proportions. Smooth successive pose changes with correct anatomy, no extra hands/feet, no cropped ears/tail/shoes. This is one coherent motion, not different characters.
